name: Detail Daemon schedule
plain: Keeps the real schedule but tells the model the sigma is a little lower than it is, by an amount that follows a per-step ramp. The model removes less noise than the sampler expects, leaving more fine texture. Its ramp is a separate schedule: rises to a peak at bias between start and end, then falls. The original ComfyUI-Detail-Daemon pack has no source in the library; this is read from copies in other packs (compared by reading one, not diffed).
math:
Ramp over steps n: mid = start + bias·(end−start); up-values on [i_start, i_mid], down on [i_mid, i_end].
v(u) = u or ½(1−cos πu) (smooth), then v^exponent, scaled to span offset → amount. Outside: start_offset / end_offset. All × (1−fade).
At model call with sigma σ: look up m(σ) by lerp between neighbouring steps' ramp values.
σ_model = σ · max(1e-6, 1 − 0.1·m(σ)·cfg). Real step uses unchanged σ.

props.shape: amount ramp per step, sigma multiplied at call
props.params: start, end, bias, amount, exponent, start_offset, end_offset, fade, smooth, cfg_scale_override
